**brain:ui server serves the read model in-process**

PR 1 of #881: brain/scripts/ui/server.mjs starts an HTTP server (default port 3000, --port/--root overrides, port 0 for ephemeral). GET / serves a static placeholder from ui/static/index.html; GET /api/snapshot composes buildSnapshot() in-process with a cache-only forge port (forge-cache.mjs, D1) — never shells out, never touches a live vcs port. forge-cache.mjs exposes exactly the four read verbs readForge calls (issueList, issueView, mrList, prReviews); a cache miss throws 'the first forge poll has not completed' rather than fetching, so graph/prs/reviews degrade to {ok:false,reason} in band until the poller (PR 2) fills it. diff.mjs is a pure section-level diff over the snapshot's top-level keys (isDeepStrictEqual), excluding generatedAt and tier, ready for PR 2's SSE hub. Every route in this PR accepts GET/HEAD only; the method check runs before routing, so POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE answer 405 with Allow: GET, HEAD on every path, known or not (R881-5's boundary for this PR's route set). Unknown paths answer 404. parseArgs follows snapshot-cli.mjs's manual-loop grammar (--port, --root); EADDRINUSE is treated as the same class of operator error as a bad argument, prints the port number and exits 2. package.json gained brain:ui (brain:<noun> convention) and engines.node >= 22. Tests: A4 (GET /api/snapshot deep-equals in-process buildSnapshot on the same fixture root/clock/port), A5 (every route completes with a forge-cache-composed port, which structurally has no write verb to call). Full suite: 5362/5362 passing (baseline 5341 + 21 new tests).
